source: sf host model of the MX engine (matches the emulator's dot_wide and heuristic golden cases bit for bit); to confirm on the RTL
format: a: (M, K) codes, b: (K, N) codes, shift: an int or an array broadcastable to (M, N), every element -32..31. out = POP(a @ b, shift), overflow / underflow as 0/1 masks. Widths sf4-sf8 use the SF8 block, sf9-sf16 the SF16 block.
